text: 郑州银行公告，经国家金融监督管理总局河南监管局和中国人民银行批准，本行发行的2026年无固定期限资本债券于2026年10月13日簿记建档，2026年10月15日完成缴款，发行规模为100亿元，前5年票面利率为1.88%。募集资金将用于补充本行其他一级资本。
text_en: Bank of Zhengzhou announced that, with approval from the Henan Regulatory Bureau of the National Financial Regulatory Administration and the People's Bank of China, the bank's 2026 undated capital bonds were bookbuilt on October 13, 2026, and payment was completed on October 15, 2026. The issuance size was RMB 10 billion, with a coupon rate of 1.88% for the first five years. The proceeds will be used to replenish the bank's additional Tier 1 capital.
